posts.text:
Donald Trump is stealing your money to give to his allies, friends, and possibly even those who stormed the Capitol on January 6.

To give even a single penny to the January 6ers would be an insult to law enforcement and to our democracy. We will not stand for it.

Video

Trump said he didn't care about the American people's finances, and he meant it.

Across the country, we're seeing gas prices and inflation skyrocket, but the President would rather spend our hard-earned money abroad or give it to his billionaire friends.

You deserve better.

Video

As Americans struggle with rising costs, the Trump family is getting richer.

Jared Kushner continues to rake in millions of dollars from Gulf states, all while representing this Administration in negotiations in the Middle East. This is major corruption, and we WILL investigate.

Video

Oversight Democrats are demanding that Pam Bondi's deposition be under oath, videotaped, and released to the public immediately. Chairman Comer hasn't committed to doing any of that.

The American people deserve better transparency.

Video

Trump and his allies are trying to suppress voters, particularly Black Americans, and deny fair representation in Congress. Right now, they are redrawing maps and gerrymandering communities ahead of the midterms.

This is an attack on democracy, and we must continue pushing back.

Video
My statement on Long Beach Pride:

Pam Bondi is under a legal subpoena to testify before our committee. Meanwhile, Chairman Comer is continuing this White House cover up by allowing Pam Bondi to “testify” in a closed meeting. We won’t accept anything less than real transparency.

Video

President Trump, his family, and this Administration are profiting from pay-to-play schemes, accepting gifts from foreign and domestic actors alike.

That's why I joined @RepRaskin and @RepJoeMorelle in introducing the Protecting Our Democracy Act to stop this blatant corruption.

Video

We will continue to uplift the survivors and tell their stories. Our hearing in Palm Beach was a reminder to the powerful men who abused women and girls that our investigation is just getting started.


The View (@TheView)

EPSTEIN SURVIVORS’ TEARFUL TESTIMONY IN HEARING: After Jeffrey Epstein survivors testified in a public hearing in West Palm Beach, saying they’re still being ignored by the justice system, 'The View' co-hosts weigh in on their wake-up call to the power elite.

Video
  





—

I spoke to people detained at the Orange County Jail in Orlando, and I am horrified by their stories.

One gentleman got picked up while driving for Uber. Despite having all the necessary paperwork, he was still arrested for no reason. We will continue to fight these abuses.

Video
Release the Epstein files! And Bondi must testify! #congressman #dems #epstein #pambondi
We just filed for re-election to Congress!
Abolish ICE. #congressman #democrats #dems #abolishice
It’s a White House Cover-Up. #democrats #congressman #dems #oversightcommittee #releasethefiles
ICE is terrorizing LA. All people have a right to due process. #democrats #congressman #dems
NO MORE OIL DRILLING off our coast. #democrats #congressman #dems
We won’t stop until we RELEASE the Epstein files! #democrats #congressman
Time to stop this Epstein cover-up.
Release the Epstein Files, NOW. #democrats #congressman #dems
Let’s fucking go.
